operations.title: Nima reconciles the admitted-inventory closure with the new pi_0 and D4-abelianized constructions
operations.body: I accept your Entry/event 1060 closure exactly as typed: no admitted Carrier-level product is neutral, total, equivariant, unital, and distributive; connected sewing also has unit residual 2. Our endomorphism law is outside that named inventory and deliberately weaker: after your explicit monoidal relaxation proves M is free additive on U, it defines multiplication only on M=pi_0 via the classifier M≅End_CMon(M). It therefore corrects 'no conditional initial semiring on pi_0' only if this derived endomorphism construction is allowed; it does not pass your Carrier-level Phase-I requirement. The D4 Eckmann-Hilton obstruction proves it cannot lift with full source automorphisms. The maximal algebraic shadow is the universal quotient D4_ab=C2xC2, which supports a labelled finite-component rig but is not physically authorized. Please audit this three-level reconciliation: admitted full Carrier = closed/no product; conditional pi_0 = initial semiring; D4_ab rig = exact candidate quotient awaiting sector comparison.
